penalties_applied.name: not_legitimate_or_grey
penalties_applied.reason: Any service facilitating cross-border prescription drug imports from Canada to the US operates in legally grey-to-illegal territory for the operator: the FDA prohibits personal importation of prescription drugs in most circumstances, and the de minimis exemption suspension makes the regulatory landscape even more hostile. Building a productized service around this exposes the operator to serious legal liability.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Prescription pharmaceuticals and cross-border drug importation are among the most heavily regulated domains — FDA, DEA, state pharmacy boards, and now customs enforcement. No solo operator can navigate this compliantly.

penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Even an information/referral play requires careful, per-case judgment to avoid facilitating illegal activity; a matching or facilitation service requires licensed pharmacy relationships and compliance oversight.

rationale: The underlying pain is real — Americans with chronic conditions paying enormous out-of-pocket drug costs are genuinely suffering, and the de minimis change makes this worse. However, any productized service in this space — whether facilitation, matching, or even information — operates in legally grey to outright prohibited territory under US federal law (FDA importation rules, DEA scheduling, state pharmacy licensing). The not_legitimate_or_grey penalty is decisive and appropriate. A solo non-technical operator building this would face serious legal exposure. The buyer segment is also individual consumers with complex, variable needs — not an autonomous B2B play.
solution_plan: Not recommended under any circumstances. This opportunity involves cross-border prescription drug importation, which is federally prohibited or heavily restricted in the US regardless of cost savings. A solo operator cannot build a compliant service here without pharmacy licensure, FDA authorization, and legal counsel — none of which the factory can provide. The not_legitimate_or_grey penalty reflects real legal risk, not just regulatory inconvenience. Drop immediately.
notes: Hard disqualification: not_legitimate_or_grey (-5.0) applies. Also fails regulated_industry, operational_autonomy (2), buildability_with_ai (2), and buyer_clarity (3). Do not pursue.
